title: Tenma Tsukasa — Taking The Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: ArcLand

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Our workshop begins today!
Are you two resolved and ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aye, captain!
My motivation tanks are completely full!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm also ready...
But this is embarrassing. Can we leave it there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! It's our first day! It's important to be excited!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, this is an incredibly valuable opportunity for us to learn from the world's best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We must learn as much as we possibly can from this workshop!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm not just taking about the incredible teachers they've gathered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We stand to learn a lot from the other cast members who will be participating alongside us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
They taught us a lot when we did that show together...
Hey, you guys!
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's wonderful to see all of you again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We didn't get a chance to talk during orientation, so I'm glad we're able to now!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, we're also really glad to see you guys.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Last time we talked would have been that joint-performance. How have you guys been? Good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we've been super duper wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Haha. You haven't changed at all, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You all seem to be doing well, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You really surprised us during orientation. I certainly didn't expect a song of welcome...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: It's been so long that we felt that we should surprise you all by doing something fun.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We were crushed when we weren't chosen to be the greeters, so we decided to steal the spotlight back from Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
I suppose we shouldn't expect anything less from a group of true entertainers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Darn it. Now I feel like I should've come prepared with something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This isn't a competition.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Still, we couldn't believe it when we heard that you'd be participating in one of our workshops.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we couldn't be more thankful to be given this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've actually been working with...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Wow, so you guys have been training with all kinds of troupes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and now we've been given an opportunity to learn here with all of you from ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm actually kinda relieved.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: We had heard that Wonderlands×Showtime had left the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We were afraid that we'd never get to see the four of you do another show.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: So it's great to hear that the four of you are still doing your best together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for being so concerned about us!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Haha. Hey, we're comrades who stood on the same stage together, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: You really lit a fire under us during that exchange.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: And I'm sure this time will be no different.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: I mean, we get to see just how much you guys have all grown, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. We promise to do our best to deliver just that.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We can't wait.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you guys later.
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't realize they were so worried about us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I was a little surprised... But I feel really happy now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. They even said that they wanna see us do another show together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm glad we had a chance to talk to them before the workshop got underway. I feel even more motivated now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They have high hopes for us, so we need to do our best to not disappoint them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's take everything that we've learned through our training and throw it at this workshop!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Yeah!
